nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$ and let $\mu$ be an isotropic log-concave probability measure on $\mathbb{R}^n$, with inverse Cheeger constant $\psi(\mu) \in [0, \infty]$ and smooth Poincaré constant $C_P(\mu) \in [0, \infty]$. Then $\frac{1}{\pi} \psi(\mu)^2 \le C_P(\mu)$.

nodes.summary: On every pseudometric space $E$ equipped with a σ-algebra, the zero measure has inverse Cheeger constant $0$.

nodes.summary: For a measure $\mu$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$, the inverse half-space Cheeger constant of $\mu$ is $h^{-1}$, where $h \in [0, \infty]$ is the half-space Cheeger coefficient of $\mu$ and the inverse is taken in $[0, \infty]$, so that $0^{-1} = \infty$ and $\infty^{-1} = 0$.
nodes.title: Inverse half-space Cheeger constant

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha = 1 + \bigl(1 + 7\sqrt{2} + \sqrt{53 - 4\sqrt{2}}\bigr)/8$. There are a real $C > 0$ and an integer $N \ge 3$ such that for every $n \ge N$ the dimensional KLS constant $\psi_n \in [0, \infty]$ satisfies $\psi_n \le C (\log n)^{\alpha}$.
nodes.title: Jambulapati–Lee–Vempala polylogarithmic bound on the KLS constant

nodes.summary: There are a real $C > 0$ and an integer $N \ge 3$ such that for every $n \ge N$ the dimensional KLS constant $\psi_n \in [0, \infty]$ satisfies $\psi_n \le C \sqrt{n}$.
nodes.title: Kannan–Lovász–Simonovits bound on the KLS constant

nodes.summary: There are a real $C > 0$ and an integer $N \ge 3$ such that for every $n \ge N$ the dimensional KLS constant $\psi_n \in [0, \infty]$ satisfies $\psi_n \le C (\log n)^5$.
nodes.title: Klartag–Lehec polylogarithmic bound on the KLS constant

nodes.summary: There is a real $C > 0$ such that for every integer $n \ge 2$ the dimensional KLS constant $\psi_n \in [0, \infty]$ satisfies $\psi_n \le C \sqrt{\log n}$.
nodes.title: Klartag's square-root-logarithmic bound on the KLS constant

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$ and let $\mu$ be an isotropic log-concave probability measure on $\mathbb{R}^n$, with inverse Cheeger constant $\psi(\mu) \in [0, \infty]$ and smooth Poincaré constant $C_P(\mu) \in [0, \infty]$. Then $\frac{1}{9} \psi(\mu)^2 \le C_P(\mu)$.
nodes.title: Lower Poincaré–Cheeger comparison with coefficient 1/9

nodes.summary: For every $C \in [0, \infty]$, the KLS constant is at most $C$ if and only if, for every positive integer $n$ and every isotropic log-concave probability measure $\mu$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$, the inverse Cheeger constant of $\mu$ is at most $C$.
nodes.title: Bounding the KLS constant measure by measure

nodes.summary: For every $C \in [0, \infty]$, the KLS constant is at most $C$ if and only if, for every positive integer $n$, the dimensional KLS constant in dimension $n$ is at most $C$.
nodes.title: Bounding the KLS constant dimension by dimension

nodes.summary: The KLS constant is finite if and only if there is a real number $C$ such that, for every positive integer $n$ and every isotropic log-concave probability measure $\mu$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$, the inverse Cheeger constant of $\mu$ is at most $\max(C, 0)$.
nodes.title: Finiteness of the KLS constant

nodes.summary: The KLS constant is the supremum in $[0, \infty]$ of the dimensional KLS constants in dimension $n$, taken over all positive integers $n$.
nodes.title: KLS constant

nodes.summary: Let $\Sigma \in [0, \infty]$ be the thin-shell variance constant: the supremum, over all dimensions $m \ge 1$ and all isotropic log-concave probability measures $\mu$ on $\mathbb{R}^m$, of $\frac{1}{m} \int (\lVert x \rVert^2 - m)^2 \, d\mu(x)$. There is a real $C > 0$ such that for every integer $n \ge 3$ the dimensional KLS constant $\psi_n \in [0, \infty]$ satisfies $\psi_n^2 \le C (\log n)^2 \, \Sigma$.
nodes.title: Dimensional KLS constant versus thin-shell variance, up to a squared logarithm

nodes.summary: There are a real $C > 0$ and an integer $N \ge 3$ such that for every $n \ge N$ the dimensional KLS constant $\psi_n \in [0, \infty]$ satisfies $\psi_n \le C n^{1/4}$.
nodes.title: Lee–Vempala bound on the KLS constant

nodes.summary: There are a real $C > 0$ and an integer $N \ge 3$ such that for every $n \ge N$ the dimensional KLS constant $\psi_n \in [0, \infty]$ satisfies $\psi_n \le C (\log n)^{3.083}$.
nodes.title: Lehec's reported polylogarithmic bound on the KLS constant, weakened

nodes.summary: Let $\mu$ be a measure on $\mathbb{R}^n$ and let $C \le D$ in $[0, \infty]$. If $C$ is a smooth Poincaré bound for $\mu$, then so is $D$.

nodes.summary: For every measure $\mu$ on a pseudometric space $E$, the outer Minkowski boundary measure of the empty set with respect to $\mu$ is $0$.

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$, let $\mu$ be an isotropic log-concave probability measure on $\mathbb{R}^n$, and let $\psi_\mu \in [0, \infty]$ be the inverse Cheeger constant of $\mu$. Then the smooth Poincaré constant of $\mu$ is at most $4 \psi_\mu^2$.
nodes.title: Cheeger's inequality for isotropic log-concave measures

nodes.summary: Let $\mu$ be a measure on $\mathbb{R}^n$ and let $C \in [0, \infty]$. If $C$ is a smooth Poincaré bound for $\mu$, then the smooth Poincaré constant of $\mu$ is at most $C$.

nodes.summary: The smooth Poincaré constant of a measure $\mu$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$ is the infimum in $[0, \infty]$ of all $C \in [0, \infty]$ that are smooth Poincaré bounds for $\mu$; it is $\infty$ when $\mu$ has no smooth Poincaré bound.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
